title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6 'Astra' Model: OpenAI officially released GPT-6 Astra, demonstrating autonomous computer-use capabilities, Lean formal proofing, and achieving a 66% score on ARC-AGI-3 (nearing 100% with continuous conversation harnesses).

US Senators Propose AI Pause Bill: Senators Bernie Sanders and Greg Casar introduced the 'Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act', calling for a nationwide halt on AI systems matching or exceeding human cognitive performance.
Broadcom Outlines $350B AI Chip Target & Q3 Beat: Broadcom ($AVGO) reported Q3 revenue of $29.6B (+86% YoY) and projected $350B in total AI semiconductor shipments over the next 2 years.
Meta Releases Muse Spark 1.3 Coding Model: Meta introduced Muse Spark 1.3, achieving an 88.8 score on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and matching GPT-5.6 Sol coding capabilities.
Antigravity Resets Gemini 3.8 Flash Quotas: Antigravity co-founder Varun Mohan announced quota resets for Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash, citing heavy TPU cluster usage following the model's launch.

items.title: @OpenAI: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra for General Computer Use
items.body: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Astra, designed to automate complex desktop and web software workflows fast and autonomously across full computing environments.

items.title: @fchollet: François Chollet Analyzes GPT-6 Astra on ARC-AGI-3 Benchmark
items.body: François Chollet reported that GPT-6 Astra scored 66% on ARC-AGI-3 using standard evaluation and nearly 100% with continuous compaction harnesses, displaying symbolic world modeling behavior.

items.title: @AndrewCurran_: US Lawmakers Introduce Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act
items.body: Senators Bernie Sanders and Greg Casar introduced legislation calling for a pause on frontier AI development and banning systems exceeding human cognitive performance.

items.title: @_mohansolo: Antigravity Resets Gemini 3.8 Flash API Quotas Amid TPU Spike
items.body: Antigravity co-founder Varun Mohan announced TPU quota resets for developers building on Google's newly released Gemini 3.8 Flash model.

items.title: @ClaudeDevs: Anthropic Previews Function Hooks for Claude Code Customization
items.body: Anthropic's developer team showcased upcoming Function Hooks in Claude Code, enabling developers to customize and automate internal agent behaviors.

items.title: @nasqret: Mathematician Demonstrates Real-Time Lean Proofs with GPT-6 Astra
items.body: Researcher Bartosz Naskręcki demonstrated using GPT-6 Astra to formalize mathematical proofs live in Lean alongside Codex code generation.

items.title: @lennysan: Lenny Rachitsky Partners with SpaceX AI for Grok Bot Access
items.body: Lenny Rachitsky announced a partnership offering annual newsletter subscribers free access to Grok Bot for productivity workflows.

items.title: @amitisinvesting: Broadcom ($AVGO) Projects $350B AI Chip Shipments Through FY28
items.body: Broadcom reported Q3 revenue of $29.6B (+86% YoY) and outlined guidance forecasting $230B in annual AI semiconductor revenue by FY28.

items.title: @amitisinvesting: Meta Launches Muse Spark 1.3 Coding Model Matching GPT-5.6 Sol
items.body: Meta released Muse Spark 1.3, achieving an 88.8 score on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and expanding open coding capabilities for developers.

items.title: @amitisinvesting: Neocloud Nscale Targets IPO with $103B Contracted Revenue Pipeline
items.body: Nvidia-backed GPU cloud provider Nscale presented IPO materials citing $103 billion in long-term compute contracts, including a $45B agreement with Anthropic.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: 15-Year Asset Returns Highlight Bitcoin and Nvidia Growth
items.body: Financial market overview noted that a $1,000 investment made 15 years ago would equal $8.97M in Bitcoin, $735K in Nvidia, and $231K in Tesla.

items.title: @saylor: Michael Saylor Declares Market Turning Point for Bitcoin
items.body: MicroStrategy Chairman Michael Saylor issued a bullish note to market bears as Bitcoin consolidated key resistance levels.

items.title: @Apple: Apple Invites Media to Fall Event Scheduled for September 9
items.body: Apple confirmed its annual fall product keynote set for September 9 at Apple Park to announce new hardware and Apple Intelligence features.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano: José Mourinho Criticizes Raúl Asencio's Off-Pitch Conduct
items.body: Fenerbahçe manager José Mourinho publicly addressed Real Madrid defender Raúl Asencio, praising his training dedication while calling out off-pitch behavior.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano: Liverpool Excludes Federico Chiesa and Wataru Endo from Champions League
items.body: Liverpool officially left Federico Chiesa and Wataru Endo out of their registered squad for the upcoming UEFA Champions League stage.

items.title: @GBC_Press: Former President Obama Responds to Foreign Policy Heckler
items.body: During a public appearance, former President Barack Obama responded to a heckler, noting he is no longer in office and does not direct current US foreign policy.

items.title: @NFL: Josh Allen Voted #2 on NFL Top 100 Players of 2026
items.body: Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen was voted #2 overall in the NFL Top 100 Players of 2026 player rankings.

items.title: @cuichenghao: Chinese Influencer Xiaohei Zhuming Arrives in San Francisco
items.body: Popular Chinese content creator Xiaohei Zhuming arrived in San Francisco, joining fellow commentators Yuan Tengfei and Liang Hongda in the US.
